question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.**

My mother looked at Sana and me with her mouth __slight openly__.
solution: The correct answer is **'slightly open'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'slightly open'** should be used instead of** 'slight openly'.** • We know that a word that adds more information about place, time, manner, cause or degree to a verb, an adjective, a phrase or another **adverb**. (समय, स्थान, कारण आदि के संबंध में अधिक जानकारी देने या क्रिया, विशेषण, वाक्यांश या अन्य क्रियाविशेषण की श्रेणी को दर्शानेवाला शब्द; क्रियाविशेषण) • *Example: In **‘speak slowly’,** **‘extremely funny’, ‘arrive late’ and ‘I know her well’, ‘slowly’, ‘extremely’, ‘late’ and ‘well’** are **adverbs**.* • In the given sentence the use of '**Openly**' is wrong. • To modify the word '**open**' we need to change its nearest word '**slight**' to '**slightly**'. • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__** *My mother looked at Sana and me with her mouth **slightly** **open**.* 41:T56c, The correct answer is **'The biggest and best part of a whole'.**
